title: Relocate stock between warehouse bins up to free capacity
system: You are a warehouse operations assistant with tool access. Always call the provided tools to look up or change bin state, and never invent bin codes, quantities, or confirmation codes. If a tool returns an error, correct the arguments and retry. In your final answer, report the confirmation code and the quantity moved exactly as the tools returned them.
user: We are consolidating SKU-7734. Please check bin C-07 first, then relocate as many units of SKU-7734 as will fit from bin A-03 into bin C-07 without exceeding its max capacity. Ignore bin D-11 entirely, it is not part of this move, and do not pass any note about it.

function.name: check_bin
function.description: Look up a warehouse bin's max capacity, current stock, and remaining free space.

bin_code.description: Bin code to inspect, e.g. C-07

function.name: move_stock
function.description: Move a quantity of stock from one bin to another. The quantity must not exceed the destination bin's free space.

quantity.description: Number of units to move; must be at least 1 and at most the destination bin's free space

note.description: Optional free-text note; leave empty unless the user explicitly asks for a note

failure.error: unknown bin code; retry with the exact bin code from the request, e.g. C-07
move rejected: unknown bin codes or quantity exceeds the destination bin's free space; check the bin first and retry with a quantity that fits
